title: Refund policy
text: Domestic ticket refunds depend on the fare rules and cancellation timing.

title: Booking confirmation
text: A booking can remain pending after payment until the provider confirms the reservation.

title: Provider timeout
text: Provider timeouts should be retried according to the retry policy before escalation.

title: VIP support
text: High-value VIP cases may require human review before a refund is approved.

title: Payment reconciliation
text: Captured payments without confirmed bookings require reconciliation between payment and reservation records.
